correctness.rationale: A proper power, necessarily a cube in weight three, yields a self-border; distinct rotations yield a cross-border. Removing the n/3 cubes when 3 divides n and dividing by the primitive orbit size n gives the floor bound. In the construction, proper suffixes starting at the second one have length at least b+1 and two ones while any corresponding prefix has three; suffixes starting at the third one have length at least h+1 and one one while any corresponding prefix has at least two. Suffixes starting with zero are excluded by the first symbol. The count hb-h(h+1)/2 attains the bound in all three residue classes. For n=3 the only word is 111 and the empty code attains zero. Orbit saturation proves the converse for every optimal code; the theorem does not assert that arbitrary transversals are non-overlapping. The supplied verification notes and script were inspected, not executed. Separate bounded reproduction (branches/cb444601-edb8-41de-846e-802c63c67ac3/independent_check.py and independent_check.log) checked all proper lengths for 53,940 ordered construction pairs and exact primitive-orbit coverage for 3<=n<=26.
